title: Pure Rokket
summary: Rokket and Borrel cards with the generic DARK Dragon Links and Fusion Spells built for them, plus generic staples. Almost every Rokket effect locks the Extra Deck to DARK monsters for the rest of the turn, so the Extra Deck is built around DARK Dragons.

summary.title: Starters
points: Rokket Loader searches a Level 7 DARK Dragon on summon (Absorouter Dragon or Noctovision Dragon) and turns a monster DARK from the GY.
Rokket Tracer destroys a face-up card you control as a Quick Effect to Special Summon a Rokket monster from the Deck.
Quick Launch Special Summons any Rokket monster from the Deck without using your Normal Summon.
Absorouter Dragon Special Summons itself while you control a Rokket and searches any Rokket monster when sent to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Rokket Loader or Rokket Tracer
steps: Normal Summon Rokket Loader to search Absorouter Dragon, Special Summon Absorouter Dragon, and Link Summon Striker Dragon to search Boot Sector Launch while Absorouter searches Rokket Tracer.
Activate Boot Sector Launch to Special Summon Rokket Tracer, link into Breachborrel Dragon (searching Borrel Reboot, Double Interlock, or Rapid Trigger) and Trisborrel Dragon.
Fuse into Borreload Fatalflare Dragon or Borreload Furious Dragon and climb into Link-5 Borrelend Dragon or Borrelshroud Dragon.

summary.title: Link-Target Destruction Engine
summary.text: Main Deck Rokkets—Silverrokket Dragon, Magnarokket Dragon, and Hollowrokket Dragon—can destroy themselves as a Quick Effect when a Link Monster targets them, sniping a card from the opponent's Extra Deck, sending a monster on the field to the GY, or banishing from the top of their Deck before replacing themselves with a new Rokket from the Deck in the End Phase. Breachborrel Dragon also summons a Rokket from the Deck whenever its targeted monster leaves the field.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Borrelend Dragon cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects or targeted by monster effects, attacks all opponent's monsters, and targets an Effect Monster on the field and a Rokket in your GY to negate that monster and revive the Rokket without allowing opponent responses.
Borrelshroud Dragon destroys a Rokket to negate a face-up card on the field and Special Summons a Link-4 or lower Borrel from the Extra Deck during the Battle Phase.

Borreload Furious Dragon destroys one monster you control and one card the opponent controls as a Quick Effect, while Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres bounces a face-up card before the DARK lock applies.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Boot Sector Launch Special Summons up to two Rokkets with different names from your hand, or from your GY if the opponent controls more monsters.
Double Interlock and Rapid Trigger Fusion Summon DARK Dragon Fusions by banishing from the GY or destroying your own monsters on the field.
Borrel Reboot Tributes a Rokket or Borrel monster to negate a Spell or Trap activation and Set it back on the opponent's field.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Borreload Savage Dragon is Forbidden in the TCG. Rokket Barrage, Borreload Liberator Dragon, and Triple Borrel Launch release in the TCG on 12 November 2026. The page's Red-Eyes, Metalmorph, Bystial, and Dragunity hybrid packages are omitted in this pure build.

main: Rokket Loader
2026 support. Summoned: searches a Level 7 DARK Dragon; from the GY, makes a monster DARK.
Rokket Tracer
Quick Effect: destroys a card you control to summon a Rokket from the Deck.
Absorouter Dragon
Summons itself next to a Rokket; sent to the GY, searches a Rokket monster.
Rokket Detonator
2026 support. Summons itself next to a DARK Dragon Link and revives a DARK Dragon equipped as a card.
Hollowrokket Dragon
2026 support. Targeted by a Link: destroys itself to banish from the top of their Deck; summons a Rokket at the End Phase.
Silverrokket Dragon
Targeted by a Link: destroys itself to banish a card from their Extra Deck; summons a Rokket at the End Phase.
Magnarokket Dragon
Targeted by a Link: destroys itself to send a monster to the GY; summons a Rokket at the End Phase.
Noctovision Dragon
Summons itself when a DARK Dragon arrives; draws as Link Material.
Rokket Caliber
Summons itself where a DARK Link points; Tributes itself to summon a DARK Dragon from the hand.
Quick Launch
Quick-Play: summons a Rokket from the Deck.
Boot Sector Launch
Field Spell that Striker Dragon searches: summons two Rokkets from the hand or GY.
Double Interlock
2026 Trisborrel search: Fusion Summons from the GY, banishing a Rokket as material.
Rapid Trigger
Quick-Play Fusion by destroying your own DARK Dragons, triggering the Rokkets.
Borrel Reboot
2026 support. Counter Trap: negates a Spell/Trap and Sets it on their field.
extra: Breachborrel Dragon
Newest support. Link-2: searches a Borrel Spell/Trap and summons a Rokket from the Deck.
Trisborrel Dragon
2026 support. Link-3: searches Double Interlock or Rapid Trigger and recycles a DARK Dragon.
Borrelshroud Dragon
2026 support. Link-5: destroys a Rokket to negate a card, and calls out another Borrel Link.
Borrelend Dragon
Link-5: negates a monster and revives a Rokket; unbreakable.
Borreload Fatalflare Dragon
2026 Fusion: searches a Rokket monster; as Link Material, destroys a card.
Borreload Furious Dragon
Fusion of two DARK Dragons: destroys one of yours and one of theirs.
Borreload Dragon
Link-4: shrinks a monster with no response and steals what it attacks.
Borrelsword Dragon
Link-4: attacks twice and halves what it hits.
Quadborrel Dragon
Link-2: destroys a monster and, if it was a Link, revives Rokkets.
Striker Dragon
Generic Link-1 for a Dragon: searches Boot Sector Launch and recycles a Rokket.
Dillingerous Dragon
Generic Link-2 for DARK Dragons: revives itself when a Rokket arrives.
Borreload eXcharge Dragon
Rank 4 for two DARK Dragons: shrinks a monster and revives a Borrel.
Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres
Link-2: tributes itself as a Quick Effect to bounce a face-up card on the field without targeting and summons a Dragon from Deck.
